items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I've used him a few times. I went up to Canada here in '73, and I took him up there with me

ctx.x: He was certainly a phenomenal player.

Oh, he was. You know, there's a little story there. I had told Andy Gibson, I said, "I want a trumpet player, a high note trumpet player, we can use, on the sensational side." He said, "Well, there are two of them, the guy that you liked when you were with Basie, played all the high lead there, and there's a guy here working in town by the name of Cat Anderson." And I said, "Well, who did he play with?" He said, "Well, as far as I know, Sabby Lewis, up in Boston, and I don't think he's played with any name bands…
